rationale: All three review lenses ran successfully. Blind lens flagged that aria-hidden propagation to the real SVG root was unverified from the diff alone; the edge-case lens confirmed by reading vite.config.ts and package.json that vite-plugin-svgr 4.3.0 defaults to expandProps: 'end', so aria-hidden does reach the rendered <svg> element, refuting the concern. Acceptance lens checked every criterion and constraint in plan.md against the diff: all pass (sentence-case aria-label, aria-hidden on the icon, title removed, ChatSidebarAccordion.tsx untouched, test mock and assertions match the plan). Two process-only criteria (test-first red/green sequence, full-suite regression run) are marked n/a — not verifiable from a static diff; these are covered by qa-gates in Stage 6. Commit message 'EPMCDME-8426: Fix duplicate role announcement on create folder button' matches the project's git-workflow.md format. No security, correctness, or blocking standards issues found. 2 findings dismissed, 2 deferred (see below) — none block.
